note:
A few sites right on the river.  Foot bridge to Lake Superior beach.  --AWH
At the mouth of the Two Hearted River on Lake Superior, 31.5 miles NE of Newberry via M-123 and County Roads 500, 414, 412 and 423; the suspension footbridge is on the west side of the campground. Day-use area on the riverbank with a developed boat launch and skid pier; salmon and steelhead runs; the North Country Trail passes by. ORVs may use the campground only to enter and exit. --Claude
